name: textarea
description: A multi-line text input styled to match Input, wrapping the native textarea
designIntent: Textarea is for free-form, multi-line text such as messages, descriptions, and feedback. Native textarea semantics keep IME, form validation, and screen-reader behavior intact.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value; omit for uncontrolled usage

examples.title: With label and helper text

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Textarea for single-line values
antiPatterns.explanation: Use Input for emails, names, and other short single-line data.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Textarea for rich text
antiPatterns.explanation: Textarea is plain text. Use a rich-text editor when formatting is required.

accessibility.implementation: Wraps textarea; multiline text entry and form validation work natively
accessibility.userRequirements: Provide an accessible name via Label or aria-label
Announce the limit in helper text, not just the placeholder

guidelines: Match the expected tone and length
